title: The Puppet Showman
summary: A traveling puppet showman traveled with a box of wooden marionettes. He wished with all his heart that his puppets could become living humans so he could manage a real theater....
full_text:
A traveling puppet showman traveled with a box of wooden marionettes. He wished with all his heart that his puppets could become living humans so he could manage a real theater.

A traveling alchemist granted his wish: the wooden puppets came to life!

Immediately, the prima donna puppet demanded a palace and diamonds; the hero puppet demanded double salary and threw tantrums; and the villain puppet refused to play his role unless he became the king! The backstage was filled with jealous quarrels, vanity, and strikes.

Exhausted and penniless, the showman begged the alchemist to turn them back into wood: "Give me back my quiet wooden marionettes! Living men are too complicated; let me manage strings rather than human pride!"
moral: Real human beings with all their flaws are infinitely more precious than mechanical puppets.
